summary: This Form 6-K filed by rYojbaba Co., Ltd., a Japanese foreign private issuer, reports the resignation of board member Takayuki Nakano effective May 7, 2026. The filing explicitly states the resignation was not due to any disagreement with company operations, policies, or practices. It lists the remaining executive officers and directors, including the appointment of Hiroyuki Oishi as CFO and principal accounting officer on March 27, 2026. No special situation—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or other corporate event—is disclosed. This is a routine board departure disclosure, equivalent to a Form 8-K Item 5.02 under US rules.
